title: Polish the playoffs page for mobile

criteria.text: Bracket names fit: at 360 and 390 px wide the team names in the bracket boxes are no longer cut with an ellipsis, except at most the two longest fake names (before: 15 of 28 cut in the 8-team bracket). Match height does not grow. Before and after shots.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/audit-main.json): team names cut with an ellipsis at 390, 360 and 320 px: bracket A 2 of 28, bracket B 2 of 28, bracket C 0 of 6 (before: 15, 8, 6). The 2 left are 34-character fake names that also cut on desktop. Box width 200 to 232 px on phone. Builder measured identical match heights; the before and after phone shots I viewed agree. Shots: before/official and final/official, bracket 500.

criteria.text: Bracket padding on phone is 8px 12px, so the first round starts near the left edge (before: 50px inside). Measured before and after.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/audit-detail.out.txt): viewer padding is 8px 12px and the first round starts 12 px from the scroller edge at 390, 360 and 320 on brackets A, B and C (9 of 9 cases). Before: 10px 50px and 50 px (before/own). Desktop shots pixel-diffed against before: no layout shift.

criteria.text: Bracket text meets 4.5:1 in dark and light themes: loser rows, winner green, and the Winner-of hint and seed grey. Contrast measured before and after.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/contrast.out.txt), real browser. Dark: winner 6.70, loser 6.25, seed 8.75, hint 8.75, Winner Bracket heading 6.15. Light: winner 5.02, loser 4.83, seed 4.83, hint 4.83, heading 4.83. Before (before/own/contrast.json): dark loser 1.98; light winner 3.30, loser 2.72, seed and hint 2.54, heading 3.95. Light, dark and winter shots viewed. The heading fix came from the independent review (2f89215).

criteria.text: The match label chip (for example WB 1.1) no longer overlaps the first row text. Measured on all matches of the 8-team bracket, phone and desktop.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/overlap.out.txt): label chip overlap on bracket A 0 of 14 matches and on bracket C 0 of 3 at phone width (chip now 0.6 px above the logo). Builder measured 124 matches across 390, 360, 320 and 1280 with 0 overlap and unchanged match boxes. I pixel-diffed the 1280 shots against before: only the chips and the loser rows changed.

criteria.text: Light theme: the division title and View buttons on the bracket list meet 4.5:1 (before: 3.74, 3.16, 3.80, 4.49). Dark theme looks the same.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/contrast.out.txt, light list): division titles 7.28, 6.72, 7.68 and View buttons 5.87, 5.68, 6.37 (before: title 3.74; buttons 3.16, 3.80, 4.49). Dark list 6.13 to 9.62 and looks the same in the before and after shots I viewed. Winter list shot viewed: readable. A new test pins the token for text and button; it fails when the Competitive button is reverted (mutation run).

criteria.text: Season picker on phone is at least 44px tall, shows the Current label at 360 px, and its dropdown rows are at least 44px tall. Measured.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/audit-main.json): season picker 44 px tall and not truncated at 390, 360 and 320; it reads Fake Season 2026 (Current). Open dropdown (final/own/360-list-season-open.png): rows 88 device px apart on a 2x shot = 44 CSS px. Desktop keeps 220x40 and 36 px rows (md: classes; builder measured).

criteria.text: The bracket card header wraps cleanly and the status badge is not clipped at 320 px. Before and after shots at 320, 360 and 390.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/audit-detail.out.txt): status badge not clipped at 390, 360 and 320 on all three brackets. At 320 the badge right edge is 256 to 258 px against a card edge of 308 px (before: 312 to 318 px, clipped). Header parts are one line each (23 px). Cosmetic: a bullet can end a line before the badge wraps. Shots: final/own/320-detail*-top.png and before/own.

criteria.text: The loading spinners are visible in the dark theme (at least 3:1) and the page loading view is announced as a status.
criteria.evidence: Spinner run on the final code (scratchpad final-spinner.out): spinner uses text-primary: 3.85:1 on dark, 5.17:1 on light (before: navy, 1.73:1 on dark per the audit). Both loading views have role=status (Loading... and Loading bracket...). New PlayoffLoadingView.test.tsx: 3 tests pass when I ran them; the builder showed them failing on the old code.

criteria.text: After tapping View Live Bracket, a loading view shows at once instead of the division list, and the screen starts at the top of the bracket. Covered by a new test and a slow-network shot.
criteria.evidence: Test first: RED 2 failed and 13 passed (fixes/fix9/tests-RED.txt), GREEN 15 of 15 (tests-GREEN.txt). Slow-network shots (fixes/fix9) at 2.6 s after the tap: before, the old list is still shown and the page is scrolled; after, the page is at the top with Loading bracket... shown and the list hidden (viewed). Unit suite passes on the final commit.

criteria.text: On phone the Live updates pill no longer covers bracket rows, buttons or footer text (it shrinks to a dot with an accessible name). Unchanged from 768px up. DEFAULT chosen without asking: Doug can veto.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/audit-detail.out.txt): on phone the signal is a 24x24 dot at 390, 360 and 320, 92 px above the tab bar; the words are sr-only with role=status and pointer-events-none. Footer text no longer covered (builder: 0 of 13 scroll positions, before 6 to 7). The dot still overlaps some bracket rows at a few positions (builder: 3 of 13 on bracket A at 390) but taps pass through. Existing RealtimeIndicator test passes. DEFAULT chosen without asking: Doug may veto; revert 468ee01 and 6ee051e.

criteria.text: Final standings rows line up: the logo column is the same for places 1 to 3 and for place 4 and below. Measured.
criteria.evidence: Final run (final/own/overlap.out.txt): the four team logos in Final Standings of bracket C are all at x=119 at 390 px (places 1 to 3 have icons, place 4 does not). Before: place 4 at x=99 (builder).

criteria.text: No new console errors; the page does not scroll sideways at 390, 360 and 320; desktop 1280 looks the same except the label-chip fix; existing tests pass; all required checks pass; the left-alone list is reported (back-to-list button, bracket spinner position, BYE text, duplicate stage title).
criteria.evidence: Official run twice more on the final code (final/official-rerun1 and 2): consoleErrors [] and overflow [] at phone and desktop. The first final run showed one console error, an outside-host manifest fetch declared in index.html (progressier.app, CORS). My diff does not touch index.html and it did not return in 2 re-runs. Own scenarios: console counts identical to before in all 9 (the 3 error scenarios keep their expected 5, 5, 4). Page width equals viewport at 390, 360, 320 on the list and brackets A, B, C. Desktop 1280 pixel-diff vs before: list page 0 px changed; brackets 0.3 to 0.6 percent, only the loser rows (no longer faded, brighter red) and the label chips. So desktop DOES change in those two ways (disclosed to Doug). Six required checks pass on 640047d. Two independent reviews: code approved, docs approved after fixes. Left alone and reported: back-to-list button, bracket spinner position and endless spinner on a corrupt bracket, BYE text, duplicate stage title, slow loading chain, error-overview wording, admin view, dead PlayoffMatchCard, dev-only CSS race, 3 doc wording nits, season-picker doc drift in 4 places.

reviews.summary: Independent review: code approved. Heading contrast and doc findings were fixed and re-checked (docs APPROVE at 640047d). Only wording nits remain.

history.summary: Review 1: Winner Bracket and Loser Bracket headings were 3.95:1 on the light page. Fixed in 2f89215.

review-heading-contrast.resolved: Fixed in 2f89215. Measured in a real browser: 4.83:1 light, 6.15:1 dark.

history.summary: Reviews 1 and 2: Playoffs docs still said the list stays on screen while loading, and described the pill only. Fixed in 9fa533d and 640047d.

review-docs-stale.resolved: Fixed in 9fa533d and 640047d. Third review APPROVE on the docs.
